answer: One concrete defense is a stake-and-reputation bond: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before joining the economy, like a marble dropped into a shared escrow jar. New identities start with zero trust and earn it slowly through attested work, so a zephyr of fresh fake accounts cannot instantly outvote honest ones. Every attestation leaves a pigment trace — a signed record of who vouched for whom — so clusters of sock-puppets show up as one color, and slashing the bond makes mass forgery unprofitable.
